ac_evidence.ac: .sdp/review_verdict.json is written on review success and review failure
.sdp/qa_verdict.json is written on qa:pass and qa:fail
Verdict artifacts carry finding_ids and blocking_ids when findings are created
Blocking findings are used as explicit rerun control, not only surfaced in logs

existing_work_summary: Review and QA verdict artifacts already existed, but blocking findings only surfaced in logs before rerun-control routing was added.
